questions.prompt: How many total litres of water are contained within all active municipal water towers in the United States?
reasoning: There are roughly 50000 municipal water towers or elevated storage tanks across the United States.
An average municipal water tower holds about 30000 litres of water.
Multiplying 50000 towers by 30000 litres per tower yields 1.5 billion litres.

questions.prompt: How many total individual letters are typed on all smartphone virtual keyboards globally in a single day?
reasoning: There are approximately 5 billion smartphone users worldwide active on a daily basis.
Each active user types an average of 1000 letters per day across messaging, email, and social apps.
Multiplying 5 billion users by 1000 letters per day results in 5 trillion letters.

questions.prompt: How many total kilograms of fresh honey are produced by all managed beehives across the continent of Africa in a single year?
reasoning: Africa has an estimated 16 million managed beehives maintained by local beekeepers.
Each managed hive produces an average of 10 kilograms of harvestable honey per year.
Multiplying 16 million hives by 10 kilograms gives 160 million kilograms.
